scenes.conflict: Radicals in her Assembly press her to cut the water outright, while her own public-trust ethic and her memory of the water ledger make her wary of weaponizing it.
scenes.goal: Maren wants to confirm that she can isolate and restore each section of the cistern, so the valves are credible leverage for recognition.
scenes.outcome: Maren proves she can control the valves and holds the radicals off for now. She commits to demanding formal recognition and fair terms before any water is shut off.
scenes.summary: In the flooded vault, Maren reads the pressure and flow of the reclamation system by sound and touch, ahead of the Assembly's demands. She resists the radicals who want the water cut and keeps the valves in reserve as her bargaining position.
scenes.title: The Valves Hold

scenes.conflict: Hardliners on the council urge riskier moves. Dario distrusts Joss for his Ring Seven origins, and the Helm Ring is running short of fresh produce.
scenes.goal: Dario wants a plan to force the elevators open without breaching a hull, and Joss wants authority to open a back channel to Ring Seven.
scenes.outcome: Dario grudgingly authorizes Joss to probe Ring Seven for talks, but only under suspicion and with a demand that he prove his loyalty.
scenes.summary: Dario cites the founding charter to call the secession a mutiny and warns that the severance threatens the ship's rotation balance. Joss argues for talks over force, and Dario sends him to the shafts to open a channel while privately doubting him.
scenes.title: The Charter on the Desk

scenes.conflict: Tamsin distrusts everyone, hedges, and keeps raising her price. Saboteurs are active around the stranded cabins.
scenes.goal: Joss wants Tamsin to guide him through the shafts toward Ring Seven, and Tamsin wants guild guarantees in exchange.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin agrees to guide Joss for a steep price plus a promise of guild rights. Joss promises more than he can deliver.
scenes.summary: Among the frozen cabins, Tamsin bargains hard, coiling her safety line as she names terms. Joss, eager to be liked, agrees to guarantees he cannot guarantee, and the two start the climb.
scenes.title: The Climbers' Price

scenes.conflict: Radicals invoke the Blight Year and the ration tithe to demand the valves be closed, and they treat compromise as betrayal. Maren's own pride makes her sympathetic to them.
scenes.goal: Maren wants the Assembly to hold to negotiation rather than cutting the water.
scenes.outcome: Maren narrowly wins a delay on the water cutoff. The Assembly gives her a short window to secure terms, and her position is weaker.
scenes.summary: Among the tiered paddies, the Assembly argues over the harvest and the water. Maren recalls her mother's cut rations and almost sides with the radicals, but wins a fragile delay.
scenes.title: Radicals on the Terraces

scenes.conflict: Saboteurs have tampered with a stranded cabin's couplings. Tamsin's father died in a coupling fall, and her instinct to hedge and delay clashes with the urgency of the crossing.
scenes.goal: Tamsin and Joss want to cross a damaged section of the shafts to reach Ring Seven's side.
scenes.outcome: They survive, and Tamsin's navigation saves them, but Joss's Concord pin and his cover are exposed to a Climber crew, which spreads word of a Concord agent.
scenes.summary: In near darkness, Tamsin maps the broken cabin and leads Joss around the sabotaged couplings. Joss's grain-stalk pin and Helm accent mark him as a Concord agent to the watching crew.
scenes.title: Sabotage in the Cabin

scenes.conflict: The Assembly sees Joss as a spy, Maren resents Tamsin for also carrying Concord agents, and Joss overpromises concessions Dario has not offered.
scenes.goal: Joss wants to pass on Dario's willingness to talk and win a private meeting between Dario and Maren in the shafts.
scenes.outcome: Maren agrees to consider a meeting in the shafts. She demands written guarantees, and Tamsin insists on her guild terms.
scenes.summary: Tamsin brings Joss into the Undercroft, where Maren tests his claims using her ledger memory and catches him exaggerating. Maren still sees an opening and agrees to consider a shaft meeting.
scenes.title: A Spy at the Valves

scenes.conflict: Dario privately knows the Ration Tithe was excessive but cannot admit it. His hardliners demand a move against the valves, and Joss's reports contain overpromises.
scenes.goal: Joss wants to win Dario's agreement to a shaft meeting, while Dario wants to learn what Ring Seven will accept.
scenes.outcome: Dario authorizes a secret meeting but sets an ultimatum. If it fails, the Concord will act against the Ring Seven valves.
scenes.summary: Dario reads Joss's report and recognizes his own tithe in Ring Seven's grievances, though he says nothing. Under pressure from his council, he accepts a meeting and sets a deadline.
scenes.title: The Tithe Ledger

scenes.conflict: Maren treats compromise as betrayal, and Dario insists the ring is in mutiny. Saboteurs threaten the cabin, and Tamsin has to choose between hedging and committing.
scenes.goal: Maren and Dario want to settle terms for the elevators and the water and harvest, face to face, without a hull breach.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin commits to protecting the cabin and the stranded passengers. Dario concedes the tithe was a mistake, and Maren agrees to give up part of her control of the valves for a binding shared water trust.
scenes.summary: Tamsin guides both leaders into a stranded cabin where saboteurs strike. She risks her guild to keep the passengers safe. In the aftermath, Dario admits the tithe was excessive, and Maren surrenders some control of the valves in exchange for a shared trust and recognition.
scenes.title: Two Rings in the Dark

scenes.conflict: Hardliners reject any admission that the tithe was wrong, and Dario's credibility and the Concord's authority are both at risk.
scenes.goal: Dario wants the Concord to accept the shaft agreement and reopen the elevators without losing its authority.
scenes.outcome: Dario concedes the tithe publicly. Joss's honest testimony about what happened in the shafts helps carry the Concord's agreement, and the Concord is saved from collapse.
scenes.summary: Before the council, Dario concedes the tithe was a mistake and puts the founding charter behind the new terms. Joss testifies honestly about the meeting and the saboteurs.
scenes.title: The Concession

scenes.conflict: Radicals say she betrayed the dead by giving up part of her control of the valves, and the Assembly distrusts Joss as a Concord liaison.
scenes.goal: Maren wants the Assembly to ratify the shared water trust and accept recognition on fair terms.
scenes.outcome: The Assembly ratifies the trust after Joss testifies and Maren makes the case. Ring Seven wins recognition and fair grain-and-water terms.
scenes.summary: On the terraces, Maren argues that a binding public trust honors the dead more than a weapon would. Joss's honest account helps persuade the Assembly, and it votes to accept.
scenes.title: The Water Trust

scenes.conflict: The couplings are damaged and the old distrust between the rings remains. Tamsin has to trust that the charter will hold.
scenes.goal: Both sides want the elevators relinked and the stranded cabins cleared, and Tamsin wants her guild's charter honored.
scenes.outcome: The elevators reopen under the new terms, Tamsin's guild receives its charter of rights, and the harvest and water begin to flow between the rings.
scenes.summary: Climber crews guided by Tamsin work with Assembly engineers and Concord officials to relink the couplings and clear the cabins. Maren and Dario witness the first cabin move, and the guild charter is signed.
scenes.title: The Spine Turns Again

logline: When the Seventh Assembly severs the elevators of the generation ship Halcyon Meridian, a water engineer and the Concord's Chief Steward must find terms for a shared water trust before sabotage or a hull breach kills the whole ship.
theme: Who owns a closed world, and what is owed to those who keep it alive
title: Ring Seven
